abstract: This paper reviews the conceptual foundations, measurement challenges, and emerging international practices in the measurement of public sector productivity. Despite the size and importance of the public sector in OECD economies, measuring its productivity remains considerably more difficult than in market sectors. Public services are usually provided free of charge and lack economically meaningful prices. The paper clarifies the statistical and methodological challenges to measure public sector productivity across countries. It then discusses the principal measurement approaches used in the System of National Accounts, including input-based, output-based, and quality-adjusted output methods, highlighting their respective strengths and limitations. The paper also reviews recent country experiences to improve the measurement of public sector productivity. The analysis concludes that, despite persistent conceptual and comparability challenges, advances in data availability and statistical methods offer significant opportunities to strengthen the measurement of public sector productivity and thereby improve the evidence base for public policy and public expenditure decisions.
authors: Orsetta Causa & Maxime Nguyen & Paul Schreyer & Tomomi Tanaka
title: Measuring public sector productivity: Concepts, challenges and international practices

abstract: This paper examines whether producer services exports improve productivity and how this effect varies across development stages. Using a panel of 156 economies over the 2006–2024 regression period, we measure productivity change with the Global Malmquist TFP index and classify economies by World Bank income status. The results show that producer services exports do not uniformly raise productivity. The positive TFP effect is concentrated in upper-middle-income economies, while the estimates for low-income, lower-middle-income, and high-income economies are less robust. This pattern is supported by shift-share IV estimates, dynamic panel specifications, alternative TFP measures, and threshold tests. Mechanism results indicate that lower-middle-income economies mainly obtain scale-efficiency gains, upper-middle-income economies benefit through technical-efficiency gains associated with resource reallocation, and high-income economies gain primarily through technological progress. These findings suggest that producer-services-led growth depends on domestic capabilities and development stage, with direct implications for how developing and post-transition economies participate in international production networks.

abstract: We examine changes in the state corporate tax rate across the U.S. and their implications on the pricing and quantity of loans. We find that the cost of credit decreases by approximately 10 basis points following a tax cut. When we account for the magnitude of tax changes, a one‐percentage‐point tax cut (hike) is associated with a 10.5 (9.2) basis‐point decrease (increase) in loan spreads. Our findings mainly originate from the demand side: large firms are able to mitigate the effects of tax increases, while less profitable firms experience larger reductions in borrowing costs following tax cuts. The effect on the equilibrium loan amount is statistically and economically insignificant, consistent with a weak supply effect and an inelastic loan supply curve.

abstract: A general industry expectation is that gas will be a required peak generation technology in the transition to net zero due to weather conditions and curtailed/delayed investment in other technologies such as pump hydro and variable renewable energy. This article investigates the corollary to this identified need: are open cycle gas turbines financially viable during the transition to net zero and longer term? Two stand-alone conventional peaking Open Cycle Gas Turbine (OCGT) plants, one natural gas and one hydrogen based, are examined over the transition to net zero in 2050 of the Australian Eastern Seaboard electricity grid. This is accomplished using a Net Present Value Discounted Cashflow modelling framework to determine if the net present value of the investing in and operating the gas generators is greater than zero – signifying a financially viable investment . Entering this modelling are estimates of the capital cost of the investment, wholesale market revenue and costs obtained from wholesale market modelling and the net proceeds to gas turbines offering CAPS hedge contracts. The wholesale market modelling was implemented using an agent-based structural model of the Australian National Electricity Market called the ‘ANEM” model’, drawing on assumptions and data published in the Australian Energy Market Operator's 2024 Integrated System Plan. Sensitivities were also investigated in the modelling and encompassed the: choice of gas turbines (e.g. older less efficient or newer and more efficient models); different weather conditions (i.e. high combined wind and solar, low solar, low wind/high solar); carbon pricing (applied to natural gas turbines); different costs of hydrogen (unsubsidised or subsidised); different modelling approaches to estimating project value beyond the forecast period linked to the wholesale market modelling if the gas generators technical life extended beyond the forecast horizon; and sensitivity to the price of CAPS contracts sold by the generator. The key findings are that: (1) open cycle gas turbines for both pure methane and pure hydrogen blends are financially viable under all weather conditions, with improved performance when variable renewable energy (both wind and solar) are poor, highlighting a heightened role of gas turbines in the firming of the grid; (2) the subsidisation of hydrogen fuel costs improves financial viability significantly; (3) the financial viability of conventional methane gas-fired turbines were fully demonstrated when operating with carbon pricing; and (4) some interesting factors capable of affecting the assessment of financial feasibility was the age/efficiency of the gas turbine, model used to extrapolate project cashflow beyond the forecast horizon used in the modelling and the price of CAPS contracts (called the premium) used in the modelling.
title: Gas turbine firming opportunities in the transition of the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM)

abstract: In this paper we examine the link between cognitive ability, risk preferences and the errors that people make. We build a unique dataset that contains almost 260,000 decisions made under risk in a variety of tasks by approximately 13,000 individuals, with each person having completed a test designed explicitly to measure their cognitive ability. Our analysis suggests that intelligence has (1) no impact on risk preferences and (2) a robust link to errors. Our results have implications for the development of theories that seek to explain the impact of cognitive ability on decision making.
title: Cognitive ability, risk preferences and errors*
title_zh: 认知能力、风险偏好与错误*

abstract: We examine how professional networks shape immigrants’ job search and labour market assimilation. Analysing displaced workers in Sweden, we show that connections to firms through conationals are especially important for immigrants’ job finding. As networks expand to include more natives, the value of such connections rises towards that seen for displaced natives. Origin homophily also predicts whether a connection provides a referral—increasing earnings and lowering turnover—rather than vacancy information. Networks account for 20 per cent of the growth in immigrants’ re-employment over their first decade after arrival; immigrants’ networks are as productive as natives’ after fifteen years.
title: Professional Networks and the Labour Market Assimilation of Immigrants

abstract: This paper studies how new varieties enter markets and become locally available. We provide causal evidence of demand externalities that operate in two steps. First, information about new varieties diffuses directly through real-world social ties among consumers. Second, early purchases generate an indirect spillover to firms: local retailers learn from “pioneer” consumers which new varieties are most likely to succeed and adjust their product offerings accordingly. We study this process in the context of direct-to-consumer imports. Using customs records on individuals’ purchases matched to population-wide social networks, international migrant links, and retailer catchment areas, we document economically meaningful demand externalities. Product-specific expenditure shocks abroad transmit through migrant networks and shift which varieties consumers purchase. Leveraging these shocks as a plausibly exogenous source of local demand variation, we show strong peer effects: prior purchases by close neighbors, coworkers, or friends increase an individual’s likelihood of purchasing the same variety, especially for premium and visible goods. We leverage this result to identify an indirect spillover from consumers to firms: retailers are more likely to add a variety to their assortment when it becomes popular among consumers in their catchment area. Combining the instrument with linked consumer–retailer data and a self-conducted retailer survey, we show that this response reflects learning about latent demand for varieties not yet stocked locally. Together, social diffusion and retailer learning generate demand multipliers that reshape local product availability and expand access to global variety.
title: How New Products Enter Markets: Social Networks, Consumer Imports, and Retailer Learning*

abstract: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 51%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.
title: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk, and Moral Hazard*

abstract: With the rapid expansion of online food delivery (OFD) platforms, subscription models have emerged as a strategic tool to retain users and shape consumption behavior. Despite their growing prevalence, the broader impacts of these subscriptions—both within the OFD sector and across downstream consumer activities—remain underexplored. Leveraging a difference-in-differences approach and a large-scale individual-level transaction data set, we identify a significant shift in consumption from a competing platform to the focal platform following the introduction of a subscription service. This shift did not result in cannibalization; instead, overall food consumption within the OFD market increased. Geospatial analysis shows that subscribers were more likely to engage in offline spillovers, including increased local dining and activity in nearby noncompeting economic sectors. These patterns suggest that subscriptions in physical services, like OFD, not only reshape digital engagement, but also, they influence consumer mobility and stimulate localized economic ecosystems. Mechanistic testing supports the interpretation that these effects are driven by increased variety-seeking behavior for offline restaurants that predominantly serve non-OFD cuisines within a proximal location, suggesting that such behavior is constrained by transportation costs. Overall, this study offers novel insights into how subscription models in physical service platforms can expand market demand, foster crosschannel engagement, and generate positive spillovers in adjacent sectors. The findings offer actionable guidance for platform designers and policymakers to enhance consumer welfare and support local economic vitality. They also provide new evidence for restaurants that additional platform usage costs may be offset by latent economic benefits from heightened consumer engagement. This paper was accepted by D. J. abstract: Economists estimate that zoning regulations raise house prices, lower productivity, and reduce aggregate welfare, yet regulations remain widespread. We develop and solve a model in which fragmented zoning authority leads to overly strict regulations: Homeowners impose stricter regulations to mitigate local congestion but fail to internalize the broader impact on metro-wide affordability. Empirically, the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of local governments explains 12% of the variation in zoning restrictiveness. Using an instrument based on 19th-century municipal fragmentation, we show that greater fragmentation leads to stricter zoning and higher housing costs. These findings suggest that centralizing zoning decisions could alleviate housing affordability challenges. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. abstract: We examine how users respond to winning symbolic awards in online crowdsourcing contests. Our setting is a machine learning competition platform that grants symbolic medals to recognize participants’ contest achievements. Employing a regression discontinuity design, we find that gold medal winners participate less in subsequent contests but engage more in prosocial activities, evidenced by a greater volume and length of posts, as well as more substantial and frequent code contributions. In contrast, bronze and silver medals do not seem to exert a significant influence on recipients’ subsequent behaviors. Drawing on self-determination theory and the needs-as-motives hypothesis, we provide evidence that need-driven goal shifting plays an important role in driving the dual effects of gold medals—diminished contest participation but enhanced prosocial contributions. Further analyses reveal that winners with previous competition medals are more likely to favor contributing content over competing again, whereas winners with more prior contribution medals are less inclined to further increase contributions. Moreover, team winners exhibit a lower tendency than solo winners to shift their efforts from competition to contribution. We add to the symbolic awards literature by uncovering a novel goal-shifting effect induced by contest medals, where award receipt redirects user effort from the focal rewarded domain to other forms of platform engagement. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. abstract: How does information transparency affect customer retention in markets where quality is difficult to verify? Conventional wisdom suggests that transparency intensifies price competition and increases customer churn. We challenge this view by showing that acquisition-stage transparency can strengthen retention in markets for credence goods characterized by delayed feedback and persistent uncertainty, where customers revisit their decisions without clear quality signals. We develop a transparency-confidence-retention framework, in which transparency at acquisition builds choice confidence, a psychological switching cost that anchors customers to their initial decisions. Using 83,835 auto insurance contracts from a European insurer and multiple identification strategies, we find that customers acquired through transparent channels are 4.6%–11.8% less likely to churn than those acquired through less transparent channels. A randomized, controlled experiment with 1,515 participants shows that transparency reduces customer churn primarily by strengthening choice confidence rather than increasing conventional switching costs, such as brand trust or product fit. Decomposing transparency into attribute, comparative, and evaluative dimensions reveals that evaluative transparency exerts the strongest influence. Analyses of boundary conditions indicate that the retention effect of transparency is amplified when public and private signals remain congruent with earlier informational cues. These findings reconceptualize transparency as a relational mechanism that fosters decisional assurance and stabilizes retention under quality uncertainty. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.02865 .

abstract: The issue of year-end spending surges is a persistent challenge in modern budgetary systems, often resulting in non-standard use of fiscal resources and inefficient budget execution. Our paper examines the role of audit institutions in mitigating end-of-year government spending surges. Using monthly fiscal data for Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2010 to 2019 and examining the effects of vertical management reform of audit agencies using a difference-in-differences design, we find that enhanced audit independence significantly curbs year-end spending surges at the local government level. More independent audit bodies increased attention to delayed fund allocation and year-end spending surges. This change was accompanied by stronger detection of fiscal irregularities, penalties, and referrals to judicial or disciplinary authorities. Moreover, the reform also increased the shares of expenditure executed in the first three quarters, indicating a reallocation of expenditure toward earlier periods. The dampening effects are more pronounced in settings where delays in budget execution are more difficult to monitor and alternative forms of fiscal oversight are weaker. Further evidence suggests that local governments subject to more independent audit oversight achieve higher fiscal expenditure efficiency. These findings highlight the previously underexplored role of audit agency independence in governing end-of-year spending behavior.

abstract: Europe is rearming at a historic pace, while military support for Ukraine is still negotiated package by package. This column compares what one euro of defence spending buys in Ukraine and in the rest of Europe. Ukrainian soldiers, howitzers and drones cost a fraction of their European equivalents and can be delivered in months rather than years. The authors argue that treating Ukraine's army and defence industry as part of Europe's own defence, financed through multi-year contracts and Russia's frozen assets, is the cheapest and fastest way for Europe to buy security.
title: From Kyiv with love (and savings): A defence win-win for Europe and Ukraine

abstract: Retrofitting homes in the United Kingdom is a critical component of achieving the country's net-zero carbon emissions target by 2050 and a contribution to climate change mitigation. This is particularly pressing as the country is home to some of the least energy-efficient housing in Europe. Retrofitting measures are scarcely adopted in the private rented sector that faces greater challenges than social or owner-occupied housing. Building on an original approach at the intersection between new economic sociology and energy demand literature, we investigate intermediary actors’ relations in shaping landlords’ retrofitting processes through interviews with experts in Brighton and Hove. Intermediary actors, and their affiliations, have a critical role in advancing retrofitting processes; however, our findings disclose a relational void which results in a dysfunctional system ‘loop’ hindering landlords’ retrofitting process. Mainstream policy focused on finance-based solutions has proven inadequate in addressing retrofitting challenges; homeowners’ decision-making has been portrayed as based on financial gains solely. Our analysis stresses the importance of accounting for relational aspects in energy retrofitting policy to uncover enabling and constraining factors on landlords’ decision-making.
title: A relational retrofitting void in the private rented sector: the Brighton and Hove ‘loop’

abstract: Offshore oil production under production-sharing agreements is characterized by large, capital-intensive, and lumpy capacity investments undertaken under fixed fiscal terms that shape the contractor’s feasible set of development and extraction options. This raises questions about which policy instruments can meaningfully influence extraction outcomes once fields have been developed. Guyana’s recent offshore development provides a useful setting for examining such extraction behavior. This paper develops a dynamic oil extraction model that integrates binding physical constraints, staged field development, and PSA cost-recovery provisions within a finite-horizon constrained optimization framework. The model is calibrated to Guyana’s Stabroek Block and used to evaluate cost-based instruments, price truncations, development restrictions and alternative fiscal regimes. The results distinguish between the intensive margin of extraction from developed fields and the extensive margin of field development. Post-development production is governed primarily by capacity and depletion constraints and is comparatively insensitive to moderate price, cost, and fiscal wedges while operating profitability remains positive. Cost recovery further dampens intensive-margin responses by cushioning contractors from recoverable policy-induced costs. However, sufficiently adverse price conditions or non-recoverable cost wedges can make profitability constraints binding and generate quantity responses. By contrast, development timing and restrictions on new field or capacity expansion have more direct and persistent effects on cumulative extraction. These findings clarify the scope of policy intervention under cost-recovery PSAs and highlight the central role of development-stage governance in shaping extraction outcomes in similar contractual regimes.
title: Oil extraction under production-sharing agreements: Constraints, development timing, and evidence from Guyana

abstract: This paper studies how informal property rights regimes that emerge in frontier environments shape the long-run development of local state institutions. I examine this question in the context of British colonial settlement on the island of Newfoundland. Early settlement relied on an informal property rights regime governing access to coastal infrastructure in the fishery. I measure historical exposure using geographic variation in proximity to flat coastline, which determined the location of early settlements and fishing sites. I show that greater exposure is associated with a lower likelihood that settlements established incorporated municipal governments during the twentieth century and increased reliance on weaker forms of local governance. Even among incorporated municipalities, historically exposed settlements were slower to adopt property taxation. Exposure is also associated with weaker formal property rights today, measured by higher rates of title conflict, and weaker political and civic engagement. These findings suggest that while informal institutions may effectively govern frontier economies, they can also discourage the long-run development of formal local state institutions.
title: Informal property rights and long-run state capacity: Evidence from local governments in Newfoundland

abstract: This paper asks whether hydrogen technology patents improve ecological performance, and under what conditions. Using a balanced panel of 48 countries over 2000–2024 and a multidimensional patent value index, we estimate two-way fixed effects models for the load capacity factor (LCF), the ratio of biocapacity to the ecological footprint. We find that hydrogen patent value is positively associated with the LCF, with a level-dependent magnitude: a one-standard-deviation increase in transformed patent value is associated with an LCF 4.2% higher for an economy at ecological balance and 6.3% higher for one in ecological deficit. This gain comes mainly from a smaller ecological footprint and only marginally from greater biocapacity. The result holds under a shift-share instrument, heteroskedasticity-based identification, weak-instrument-robust inference, plausible-exogeneity analysis and dynamic panel estimation. Turning to mechanisms, a joint parallel-mediation model attributes 6.8% of the total effect to technical human capital and 7.2% to hydrogen production subsidy policy. The association is positive in both fossil-dependence groups, without a robust difference between them, but significant only in below-median-income economies. Panel threshold estimates show that it strengthens once institutional quality exceeds approximately 0.31 on a 0–1 index, turns from negative to positive once internet penetration passes about 92%, and becomes positive and statistically significant once a country operates three or more carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS) facilities. For policy, hydrogen innovation is better assessed alongside absorptive capacity, digital infrastructure and operational carbon-management capacity than as a standalone environmental instrument.

abstract: Following the February 2021 military coup, armed conflict in Myanmar surged by more than 2000%. Against this backdrop, this study contributes to the literature by investigating how the association between conflict and agricultural performance varies by cropping period—planting, mid‐season or harvest—during two subsequent 2021 and 2022 monsoon seasons. Overall, each additional conflict incident in a township is associated with declines of 0.8% in output and 0.7% in yield, with marginal associations about twice as large in the main rice‐growing Delta region. Given that there were, on average, 20 conflict incidents per township nationwide and 8 in the Delta, these estimates imply annual cumulative declines of roughly 16% in output and 14% in yield nationally and 11% and 9%, respectively, in the Delta. The negative correlation between armed conflict and rice production varies across cropping stages, with mid‐season conflicts, when most input application activities occur, linked to the largest reductions in monsoon rice production, both nationally and in the Delta. Our results suggest that conflict‐related disruptions may operate through different adjustment margins across regions, with reductions in fertiliser use and extension access in the Delta and lower overall farm expenditure at the national level; however, our data cannot fully disentangle these channels, and further work with more granular price and expenditure data is needed to pin down and quantify the importance of each margin. These findings underscore the need for policies that enhance resilience and safeguard production in conflict‐affected agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 2021年2月军事政变后，缅甸武装冲突激增超过2000%。在此背景下，本研究通过考察冲突与农业表现之间的关联如何随种植期——播种期、中期或收获期——在随后2021年和2022年两个季风季中变化，为相关文献作出贡献。总体而言，一个乡镇每增加一次冲突事件，与产出下降0.8%和单产下降0.7%相关，而在主要水稻种植区三角洲地区，边际关联约为此两倍。鉴于全国平均每个乡镇有20次冲突事件、三角洲地区有8次，这些估计意味着全国产出和单产每年累计下降约16%和14%，三角洲地区分别下降11%和9%。武装冲突与水稻生产之间的负相关在不同种植阶段存在差异，中期冲突——即大多数投入品施用活动发生的时期——与全国和三角洲地区季风水稻生产的最大降幅相关。我们的结果表明，与冲突相关的扰动可能通过不同地区的不同调整边际发挥作用，三角洲地区表现为化肥使用和推广服务获取减少，全国层面则表现为农场总支出降低；然而，我们的数据无法完全区分这些渠道，需要利用更精细的价格和支出数据开展进一步研究，以确定并量化每个边际的重要性。这些发现凸显了制定增强韧性并保障受冲突影响农业系统生产的政策的必要性。
title: Conflict and Agricultural Performance: Evidence From Myanmar

abstract: This study examines how a digital administrative transition affects supplier eligibility and procurement competition. On 4 April 2022, the U.S. federal government replaced the DUNS identifier with the Unique Entity Identifier and introduced a new entity-validation process. We link predetermined registration-expiration dates to subsequent supplier histories, solicitations, and contract awards. A local discontinuity design retains expiration dates recorded before the transition, including for suppliers subsequently receiving administrative extensions. Suppliers scheduled to expire just after the cut-off were 12.5% points more likely to become inactive within 30 days, accumulated 7.4 additional inactive days over 60 days, and were 3.4% points less likely to obtain a contract within 180 days. Greater market exposure to post-transition renewals is associated with fewer offers, more single bidding, greater incumbent advantage, and higher prices for standardized products. The competition effect is stronger in markets dependent on small suppliers and weaker in markets with deeper historical supplier pools. These findings connect the continuity of administrative eligibility to bidder participation and the terms obtained by public buyers.
title: Administrative infrastructure and procurement competition: evidence from the U.S. supplier-ID transition
title_zh: 行政基础设施与采购竞争：来自美国供应商识别码转换的证据

abstract: The Energy-Saving and Emission-Reduction Fiscal Policy Comprehensive Demonstration Cities program represents a targeted green policy instrument and serves as an important policy initiative for advancing China’s carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. Using the implementation of this pilot program as a quasi-natural experiment, this study examines the impact of the policy on corporate green innovation based on a sample of listed firms in high-emission industries in China from 2007 to 2024. Employing a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model, we find that the Energy-Saving and Emission-Reduction Fiscal Policy significantly promotes corporate green innovation. The mechanism analysis further indicates that the alleviation of financing constraints and the optimization of human capital structure may serve as important mechanisms through which the ESER fiscal policy promotes corporate green innovation. Meanwhile, environmental regulation exerts a negative moderating effect on this relationship. Further analysis demonstrates that the positive effect of the policy on green innovation is more pronounced among large-scale enterprises, firms located in central cities, and firms in regions with stronger fiscal capacity. This study provides empirical evidence on the micro-level innovation effects of green fiscal policies and identifies the boundary conditions under which such policies influence corporate green innovation.

title: Energy-saving and emission-reduction fiscal policy and green innovation in high-emission firms: a quasi-natural experiment from China

abstract: Relative debt financing costs may contain information about internal resource allocation. This paper examines Chinese A-share firms from 2016 to 2025 using a leave-one-out premium relative to industry-year peers and a risk-adjusted premium net of observable fundamentals and industry-year conditions. Higher premia are associated with larger other-receivable balances, an accounting proxy for fund occupation. A one-standard-deviation increase in the risk-adjusted premium corresponds to an increase in other receivables equal to about 5.1% of the sample mean. The association remains in matched samples, alternative specifications, and models with industry-year and province-year fixed effects. Within-industry-year permutation tests place the observed coefficients in the upper tail of their reassignment distributions. The association is stronger among firms with persistent losses, persistent low growth, and severe financing constraints. Higher premia also accompany greater refinancing exposure and lower real investment.

title: Debt price premia and controlling shareholder tunnelling
title_zh: 债务价格溢价与控股股东掏空

abstract: This paper examines whether exposure to peers from more affluent regions adversely affects individuals’ mental health. Using administrative psychological screening data for 1.4 million Chinese college freshmen and exploiting the quasi-random assignment of students within majors to administrative classes, we identify the causal effect of classmates’ hometown affluence on mental health. We find that, conditional on students’ own home county affluence, exposure to classmates from more affluent counties significantly increases depression. The effect is particularly pronounced among students from less affluent counties and among males. The results are robust to alternative measures of peer affluence (including one based on imputed household income) and mental health, as well as alternative specifications. Our findings provide new evidence on how relative socioeconomic status affects mental health.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了接触来自更富裕地区的同伴是否会对个体心理健康产生不利影响。利用140万名中国大学新生的行政心理筛查数据，并借助学生在专业内被 quasi-random 分配到行政班级这一机制，我们识别了同班同学家乡富裕程度对心理健康的因果效应。我们发现，在学生自身家乡县富裕程度给定的条件下，接触来自更富裕县的同学会显著增加抑郁。该效应在来自较不富裕县的学生以及男性学生中尤为明显。该结果在同伴富裕程度的替代衡量指标（包括基于推算家庭收入的指标）和心理健康替代衡量指标以及替代设定下均保持稳健。我们的发现为相对社会经济地位如何影响心理健康提供了新的证据。

title: Relative affluence and mental health: Evidence from quasi-random class assignments
title_zh: 相对富裕与心理健康：来自准随机班级分配的证据

abstract: We identify a new and important property of affine term structure models: at long maturities, the slope of the term structure of risk premia becomes “almost observable”. Exploiting this property by fitting models to long-maturity data dramatically improves the precision of estimates of risk premia and expected short rates across the term structure. In a Monte Carlo experiment we show that using rates with maturities up to 25 years, rather than 10 years as is standard in the literature, reduces the standard deviation of estimation errors in risk premia, expected short rates and term premia by over 70%. Applying this approach to US Treasury data, we find that variation in expected short rates accounts for a much larger share of variation in yields (and variation in term premia a correspondingly smaller fraction) than in the widely used estimates reported by the Federal Reserve. Accounting for time-variation in yield volatility is key to successful extraction of the risk premium information in long rates. Our approach therefore departs from much of the empirical literature in two important respects: it incorporates long-maturity yields and allows for time-varying yield volatility, whereas most existing studies ignore long-term yields and rely on constant volatility models.
abstract_zh: 我们发现仿射期限结构模型的一个新的重要性质：在长到期期限上，风险溢价期限结构的斜率变得“几乎可观测”。利用这一性质，将模型拟合到长到期数据，可以显著提高对整个期限结构上风险溢价和预期短期利率估计的精度。在一项蒙特卡洛实验中，我们表明，使用到期期限最长可达25年的利率，而非文献中标准的10年利率，可将风险溢价、预期短期利率和期限溢价中估计误差的标准差降低超过70%。将这一方法应用于美国国债数据，我们发现，与美联储报告的广泛使用的估计相比，预期短期利率的变动在收益率变动中所占的份额要大得多（相应地，期限溢价变动所占的份额要小得多）。考虑收益率波动率的时间变化是成功提取长利率中风险溢价信息的关键。因此，我们的方法在两个重要方面不同于许多实证文献：它纳入长到期收益率，并允许收益率波动率随时间变化，而大多数现有研究忽略长期收益率并依赖恒定波动率模型。
title: Do long-term yields help to estimate short-term risk premia?
title_zh: 长期收益率有助于估计短期风险溢价吗？

abstract: Voluntary sustainability standards (VSS) promise consumers that certified products are produced under sustainable conditions. While the literature assessing the effects of VSS has expanded considerably, most studies rely on cross-sectional data, thereby providing only a snapshot in time, and focus on single sustainability dimensions, limiting our understanding of whether improvements in one dimension are accompanied by unintended negative effects in another. Moreover, little is known about the extent to which VSS duration influences outcomes, even though sustainability-related improvements may take time to materialize. Our study addresses these gaps using a three-wave panel dataset from Rwanda’s coffee sector to examine how VSS and their duration are associated with economic and ecological outcomes. We distinguish between state and civil-society VSS , which are developed and monitored by organizations such as governments or NGOs, and industry VSS , which include both company-owned standards and multi-stakeholder initiatives with strong industry involvement. We combine household-, buyer-, and plot-level data and draw on a unique dataset of 844 households, 102 plots and 48 coffee buyers. We find that only state and civil-society certification is positively associated with economic outcomes such as coffee yield, prices, profits and returns to land, while longer certification duration under both VSS types is associated with improvements in most economic outcomes. Ecological results are mixed. While state and civil-society certification and its duration are positively associated with shade tree outcomes, we do not observe similar associations for industry VSS. For both schemes, we find no positive associations with animal diversity outcomes. The findings highlight that VSS should be understood as a long-term process in which sustainability improvements materialize gradually. They also point to current limitations in the ability of VSS to achieve environmental objectives, particularly under industry VSS. More broadly, our findings emphasize the importance of considering time dynamics and multiple sustainability dimensions when assessing VSS effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 自愿性可持续标准（VSS）向消费者承诺，认证产品是在可持续条件下生产的。尽管评估VSS效果的文献已大幅扩展，但大多数研究依赖横截面数据，因而仅提供某一时点的快照，并聚焦于单一可持续性维度，这限制了我们对某一维度的改善是否伴随另一维度非预期负面效应的理解。此外，尽管与可持续性相关的改善可能需要时间才能显现，但关于VSS持续时间在多大程度上影响结果，仍知之甚少。本研究利用卢旺达咖啡部门的三期面板数据集来弥补这些空白，考察VSS及其持续时间如何与经济与生态结果相关联。我们区分由国家与公民社会制定和监督的VSS，以及行业VSS，后者包括企业自有标准和行业深度参与的多利益相关方倡议。我们结合农户、买家和地块层面数据，并依托一个包含844户农户、102个地块和48个咖啡买家的独特数据集。我们发现，只有国家与公民社会认证与经济结果（如咖啡产量、价格、利润和土地回报）呈正相关，而两类VSS下更长的认证持续时间均与大多数经济结果的改善相关。生态结果则好坏参半。国家与公民社会认证及其持续时间与遮荫树结果呈正相关，但行业VSS未观察到类似关联。对于两类方案，我们均未发现与动物多样性结果呈正相关。研究结果强调，VSS应被理解为一个长期过程，可持续性改善在其中逐步实现。它们还指出VSS在实现环境目标方面的当前局限，尤其是在行业VSS下。更广泛地说，我们的发现强调在评估VSS有效性时考虑时间动态和多重可持续性维度的重要性。
title: Voluntary sustainability standards and economic and ecological outcomes: panel evidence from Rwanda’s coffee sector
title_zh: 自愿性可持续标准与经济及生态结果：来自卢旺达咖啡部门的小组证据

abstract: Abstract Calorie labels are widely used as an information disclosure policy, yet their behavioural effects remain debated. Across four studies ( N = 2,067), including one nationally representative online sample of the U.S., we examine how individuals adjust portion-size choices after updating misperceptions about meal calorie content. Using more than 45,000 incentivised calorie estimates and 6,000 food choices, we find that food characteristics, not individual traits, better predict misperceptions, and that larger misestimations are associated with extreme portion choices. Portion-size adjustments after a label reveals the caloric content are substantially smaller than the initial estimation errors. Responses are asymmetric: correcting underestimation is associated with larger reductions in portion size than the increases observed after correcting overestimation. Individuals who estimate calories accurately show little to no adjustment. Increases after correcting overestimation are concentrated among healthier foods and lower-conflict eaters. These results highlight asymmetric behavioural responses to disclosed information and suggest that average calorie changes may obscure important heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 卡路里标签被广泛用作信息披露政策，但其行为效应仍存争议。通过四项研究（N = 2,067），其中包括一个具有美国全国代表性的在线样本，我们考察个体在更新对餐食卡路里含量的错误认知后如何调整份量选择。基于超过45,000次有激励的卡路里估计和6,000次食物选择，我们发现食物特征而非个体特质更能预测错误认知，且较大的估计误差与极端份量选择相关。标签揭示卡路里含量后的份量调整幅度显著小于初始估计误差。反应具有不对称性：纠正低估所伴随的份量减少幅度大于纠正高估后所观察到的份量增加幅度。卡路里估计准确的个体几乎不进行调整。纠正高估后的增加集中在更健康的食物和冲突较低的进食者中。这些结果凸显了对披露信息的不对称行为反应，并表明平均卡路里变化可能掩盖重要的异质性。
title: Asymmetric behavioural responses to updating caloric information
title_zh: 对更新热量信息的非对称行为反应

abstract: This paper examines how coupon expiration time affects consumer acceptance using observational scenario-survey data and causal machine learning. Because the mechanism assigning the expiration attribute is undocumented and responses are stated acceptance in hypothetical scenarios, we treat the two-hour (versus one-day) window as an observational exposure identified under selection-on-observables, supported by cross-fitted propensity scores, balance diagnostics, and sensitivity analysis. The Context-Contingent Time Preference (CCTP) framework supplies directional predictions about situational moderation. Inverse-probability weighting estimates the two-hour window reduces stated acceptance by 18.3% points (cluster-robust SE =0.014); propensity score matching yields ATT =−0.160 (5,305 pairs). On a held-out confirmation sample, the penalty is pervasive but amplified by urgency (βˆ=−0.087, SE =0.041) and destinations over 25 minutes away (θˆ=−0.147, SE =0.041), most severe at the intersection of solitude and urgency (−0.134, SE =0.032), and attenuated by social presence (+0.088, SE =0.022; composition-adjusted +0.047, SE =0.032). It concentrates in restaurant and coffee-house coupons and is absent for bar coupons. Simulations show effect-based targeting reduces conversion losses (29–42%) versus random allocation; propensity-based targeting performs worse than random. An E-value of 2.13 benchmarks sensitivity. Results concern stated, not revealed, acceptance.
title: Causal effects of coupon expiration on consumer acceptance: evidence from heterogeneous treatment effects in an observational scenario survey
title_zh: 优惠券到期对消费者接受度的因果效应：来自观察性情景调查中异质性处理效应的证据

abstract: Using data on local officials and local government debt (LGD) in Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2006 to 2012, this article examines the effect of gender-based affirmative action (AA) for female officials on the behaviours of their male counterparts. We find that female officials have a promotion advantage under China’s gender-based AA policies. Using the provincial share of female municipal party secretaries as a proxy for the intensity of gender-based AA, we find that gender-based AA is associated with higher LGD in male-led cities. This effect is stronger where male officials face greater promotion incentives and where female officials have higher educational attainment. We also find that this effect is more pronounced among cities led by male officials with higher competence. In addition, gender-based AA is associated with higher infrastructure investment in male-led cities. The findings suggest that, under China’s tournament-style promotion system, gender-based AA raises promotion pressure on male officials and stimulates more proactive political competition among non-beneficiaries.

title: Male officials’ response to gender-based affirmative action: evidence from local government debt
title_zh: 男性官员对性别平权行动的回应：来自地方政府债务的证据

abstract: New energy infrastructure is often met with a so-called ‘not-in-my-backyard’ mentality in local residents. While much research on this topic has focused on renewable energies, little is known about the factors influencing public opinion on where to host deep geological repositories for high-level radioactive waste. Thus, this study conducts two experiments to investigate the effects of two potential explanatory factors and how they interact in a representative sample of German residents (N = 3015). Drawing on the literature on the ‘not-in-my-backyard’ mentality, the first experiment reveals that higher spatial proximity – i.e., a smaller distance in kilometers between a person's place of residence and the potential location of a nuclear waste repository – increases individuals' perceived personal relevance of the hosting decision. However, the second experiment shows that this effect is conditioned by regional belonging . While feeling affected by the hosting decision decreases for spatially distant sites that are located outside a person's own region, perceived relevance remains high when spatially distant sites are still located within a person's own region. Furthermore, mediation analysis reveals that this moderation effect also translates into stronger opposition against the decision and a higher likelihood for individuals' opinion expression even if the site is located further away. Future research should therefore extend the idea of ‘not-in-my-backyard (NIMBY)’ and should consider public opinion on energy infrastructure also as a ‘not-in-our-backyard (NIOBY)’ phenomenon in which social collectives rather than just individuals feel affected. This may also assist policy-makers when planning participatory practices with local publics on their energy projects.
abstract_zh: 新能源基础设施常常遭遇当地居民所谓的“邻避”心态。尽管该主题的大量研究聚焦于可再生能源，但关于影响公众对高放射性废物深地质处置库选址意见的因素却知之甚少。因此，本研究开展了两项实验，在具有代表性的德国居民样本（N = 3015）中考察两个潜在解释因素的作用及其交互方式。基于关于“邻避”心态的文献，第一项实验揭示，更高的空间邻近性——即个人居住地与核废料处置库潜在选址之间以公里计的更小距离——会提高个体对选址决策的感知个人相关性。然而，第二项实验表明，这一效应受区域归属的调节。虽然对于位于个人所在区域之外的空间遥远场址，感到受选址决策影响的程度会下降，但当空间遥远的场址仍位于个人所在区域之内时，感知相关性依然较高。此外，中介分析揭示，这种调节效应还会转化为对决策更强烈的反对以及个体表达意见的更高可能性，即使场址位于更远处。因此，未来研究应拓展“邻避（NIMBY）”的概念，并应将关于能源基础设施的公众意见也视为一种“非我后院（NIOBY）”现象，即感到受影响的是社会集体而不仅仅是个人。这也可能有助于政策制定者在规划其能源项目时与当地公众开展参与式实践。
title: ‘Not in my backyard’ or ‘Not in our backyard’? The influence of spatial proximity and regional belonging on attitudes and opinion expression on site selection for a nuclear waste repository
title_zh: 邻避”还是“邻避于我们”？空间邻近性与区域归属对核废料处置库选址态度及意见表达的影响

abstract: Economic fragmentation can reshape where countries trade, but does it also reshape the currencies used to conduct international trade? We study these two margins of adjustment using third countries’ heterogeneous exposure to the U.S.–China trade war. We construct a country-level exposure measure combining the eventual Section 301 tariff schedule with pre-war product-level trade patterns and China’s pre-war presence in the U.S. import market, and trace subsequent changes in bilateral trade shares and aggregate RMB and U.S.-dollar invoicing. Greater exposure is associated with a systematic reorientation of trade toward the United States: a one-standard-deviation increase in exposure corresponds to a 1.97 percentage-point increase in the U.S. share of total trade and a 2.17 percentage-point decline in the China-minus-U.S. trade share over 2018–2021. Currency invoicing, however, does not exhibit a parallel realignment: RMB and U.S.-dollar responses differ across export and import flows rather than moving in a common direction. The results show that the geographic and monetary dimensions of international trade need not adjust together.
abstract_zh: 经济碎片化可能重塑各国的贸易流向，但它是否也会重塑国际贸易所使用的货币？我们利用第三国对中美贸易战的异质性暴露来研究这两个调整边际。我们构建了一个国家层面的暴露度量，将最终301关税表与战前产品层面贸易模式及中国战前在美国进口市场中的存在相结合，并追踪随后双边贸易份额以及人民币和美元计价总额的变化。更大的暴露与贸易系统性地转向美国相关：暴露每增加一个标准差，对应2018—2021年间美国占总贸易份额上升1.97个百分点，中国减美国贸易份额下降2.17个百分点。然而，货币计价并未表现出平行的重新对齐：人民币和美元的反应在出口流与进口流之间不同，而非朝共同方向变动。结果表明，国际贸易的地理维度和货币维度未必会同步调整。

title: Trade fragmentation without currency realignment? Evidence from the U.S.–China trade war
title_zh: 贸易碎片化而未伴随货币重 alignment？——来自中美贸易战的证据

abstract: While linear panel data models with correlated random effects maintain consistency even under misspecification of the individual effect, this robustness property fails in nonlinear settings. We address this limitation by modeling the individual effect as an unknown smooth function of time-invariant covariates, allowing an unrestricted relationship between unobserved heterogeneity and the regressors. Estimation proceeds by profile least squares, yielding N -consistent estimates of the structural parameters, which are identified without restricting the relationship between the individual effect and the covariates. Simulations confirm that the proposed estimator remains consistent when existing methods become biased and inconsistent. An application to the public capital productivity puzzle shows that flexible modeling of the production function and individual effects leads to positive and significant returns to public capital.
abstract_zh: 尽管具有相关随机效应的线性面板数据模型在个体效应设定错误时仍能保持一致性，但这种稳健性在非线性情形下不再成立。我们通过将个体效应建模为时不变量协变量的未知光滑函数来应对这一局限，从而允许未观测异质性与回归变量之间存在不受限制的关系。估计通过轮廓最小二乘法进行，得到结构参数的N-一致估计，这些参数在不对个体效应与协变量之间关系施加限制的情况下即可识别。模拟证实，当现有方法出现偏误且不一致时，所提出的估计量仍保持一致性。对公共资本生产率之谜的应用表明，对生产函数和个体效应进行灵活建模会得到公共资本正且显著的回报。
title: Nonlinear panel data models with robust correlated random effects
title_zh: 具有稳健相关随机效应的非线性面板数据模型

abstract: In a recent study, (Ekici and Bumin Yenmez, 2026) characterize top trading cycles (TTC) on the unrestricted domain by strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and pair rationality, uncovering a correspondence between the axiomatic foundations of TTC and deferred acceptance, matching theory’s two canonical rules. We show that their characterization fails on the single-peaked domain, but it holds on the single-dipped domain even without strategy-proofness. They also show that pair rationality can be replaced in their characterization by two weaker conditions concerning agents’ first and second choices. In contrast, this replacement fails on the single-dipped domain, even when strategy-proofness is imposed.
abstract_zh: 在近期一项研究中，Ekici和Bumin Yenmez（2026）通过策略防伪性、个体理性与配对理性，在无限制域上刻画了最高交易循环（TTC），揭示了TTC的公理化基础与匹配理论两大经典规则之一——延迟接受之间的对应关系。我们证明，他们的刻画在单峰域上失效，但在单谷域上即使不施加策略防伪性也依然成立。他们还表明，在其刻画中，配对理性可被关于代理人第一和第二选择的两个更弱条件所替代。相反，这一替代在单谷域上失效，即使施加策略防伪性亦然。

abstract: 加快构建中国特色社会主义政治经济学自主知识体系是超越西方经济学理论的狭隘性和局限性，深化对中国经济运行和发展独特规律的认识，形成具有主体性、原创性的理论与实践创新成果的系统性集成。从理论特征来看，作为马克思主义政治经济学中国化时代化的最新成果，习近平经济思想为构建中国特色社会主义政治经济学自主知识体系提供科学指引；从目的属性来看，对社会主义市场经济运行中商品运动规律、资本运动规律、社会主义经济运动规律三个层次规律的揭示是构建中国特色社会主义政治经济学自主知识体系的根本目的；从方法论来看，历史唯物论、唯物辩证法和实践认识论是构建中国特色社会主义政治经济学自主知识体系的方法论；从内容体系来看，中国特色社会主义政治经济学自主知识体系可以分为导论、本论和余论三个部分，充分彰显了这一理论体系的中国特色、中国风格、中国气派、中国自信。

abstract: 产业链供应链是宏观经济平稳运行的重要基础，机器人作为新型生产要素推动了制造业优化升级和“稳链强链”目标的实现。本文将任务分工模块嵌入企业全球价值链生产阶段选择模型，并拓展至多国情形及包含近端合并、远端采购的生产链情形，系统考察机器人应用对企业生产链延伸及稳链强链的影响。理论分析表明，机器人应用不仅推动了企业将邻近上游环节纳入内部生产，还通过近端合并与远端采购连接更远的上游供应商，从而同时拓展了企业内部生产边界与外部供应链范围。多国模型的数值模拟表明，机器人应用还增加了本国生产阶段的承接份额和增加值投入份额，有助于提升本国企业在全球价值链中的地位和产业链供应链整体竞争力。实证结果与理论分析、数值模拟的结论保持一致：机器人应用显著促进企业生产链延伸和稳链强链，主要体现为向上游关键环节补链，创新提质和人力资本升级是主要机制。本文为发挥机器人应用的赋能作用、提升我国产业链供应链安全及制造业竞争力提供了重要启示。

abstract: 本文构建政府与企业动态博弈模型，探究数字技术创新中的补贴机制、作用边界和退出安排，并结合2023年中国制造业数据进行仿真验证。研究表明，补贴不仅对数字技术创新企业的创新水平、市场需求、利润有促进作用，而且还因消费者对数字产品的偏好产生了产品溢价，提升了数字创新产品的价格。补贴对非创新企业形成挤压效应，因而其可能采取“骗补”行为调节利润。本文从政府对企业数字技术创新质量的甄别能力和数字技术外溢强度两个维度，给出政府补贴的有效区间：若政府甄别能力高，采用成本补贴更有效；若数字技术外溢强度高，则更适合税收补贴。为考察补贴和市场的作用关系和边界，本文从消费者数字产品选择倾向和数字技术偏好两个维度刻画市场对数字产品的需求，发现当创新企业市场占比低且消费者数字产品选择倾向较低时，加强补贴或加大消费者数字技术偏好能促使数字技术创新持续，补贴和数字技术偏好呈现互补关系；一旦消费者数字产品选择倾向突破一定阈值，均衡补贴率将随着消费者数字技术偏好的提升而下降，两者转为替代关系。进一步，本文还从提升政府甄别能力、供需两端驱动制造业数字技术创新、动态调整补贴强度和完善补贴政策体系与市场监控方面提出政策建议，为推动制造业企业数字技术创新提供新的理论依据。

abstract: 个体情绪是数字时代影响信息传播的主要因素之一。如何从微观角度分析情绪影响信息传播及个体决策的机制，对理解社会学习和群体行为具有重要的意义。本文在贝叶斯学习模型的基础上引入了行动者的情绪因素，允许行动者基于社会学习和情绪感染分享信息，从而讨论情绪对分享行为的直接影响、间接影响以及对信息传播的整体影响，为信息监管者制定差异化监管措施，实现监管前置提供理论支持。引入情绪因素不仅增加了影响行为者效用的维度，同时也引进了信息不对称（因为后续行为者可能只是观察到行为而不知行为的动因）。研究结果表明：第一，情绪会通过情绪感染直接提高信息分享，同时也会通过社会学习间接提高或降低信息分享;第二，情绪对不实信息的传播存在“反转效应”，低情绪可以降低其传播概率，高情绪则会提高其传播概率；第三，在大样本下，情绪对群体分享比例具有“开关效应”，当情绪增大超过阈值后，群体分享比例会先断崖式下降，后线性增长；第四，平台可以利用情绪的“反转效应”和“开关效应”，借助控制初期曝光率或提供情绪预警等干预手段，减少不实信息的传播。

abstract: 进一步全面深化改革、健全宏观经济治理体系是推进中国式现代化的内在要求。在第四次科技革命背景下，本文聚焦迅速崛起的信息消费，以信息消费示范城市建设为例，实证考察了供给侧结构性改革的扩内需效应。基于80余家主要电商平台零售大数据的研究发现，示范城市建设显著提高了本城市线上信息产品的销售总额和销售数量，且该效应主要源自消费需求的净增长，而非区域间、行业间或线上线下间的消费转移。机制分析表明，新型业态培育、信息基础设施完善、消费环境优化以及信息服务业集聚是示范城市带动消费提升的重要途径。异质性分析显示，低价格、低弹性、低物流依赖型商品对供给侧改革的响应更强；信息消费政策能够推动消费模式从生存型、生活型向发展改善型、生产型转变。同时，示范城市建设丰富了信息产品供给多样性，物流基础设施完善、供需协同政策能进一步放大供给侧改革的扩内需效应。最后，供需协同下的城市信息消费产业发展具有显著的经济增长带动效应，尤其表现为对第二产业和第三产业增加值的拉动。本文为供给侧结构性改革创造新增有效需求提供了微观证据，也为“十五五”时期精准扩大内需提供了有益参考。

abstract: 在共建“一带一路”背景下，中国对外基础设施投资持续扩张，但其对东道国经济的实际影响仍存在较大争议，且微观经验证据尤为缺乏。本文基于非洲发展走廊项目建设形成的准自然实验，运用多维微观数据，系统考察了中国对非基础设施投资的经济效应及其作用机制，并在统一框架下比较分析了中国与其他国家（机构）基础设施投资的经济效益差异。通过将2000—2019年中国投资的非洲发展走廊项目与10km×10km GDP网格数据进行精准匹配，本文发现，中国对非洲基础设施投资促使项目附近50km以内网格的GDP水平显著提高约1.2%。为缓解项目选址中的内生选择问题，本文通过仅保留对项目选址不起决定性影响的样本进行检验，并结合历史交通线路和最小生成树构造工具变量，结果依然稳健。机制分析中，本文基于新经济地理理论，利用收集整理的多源微观调查数据研究发现，中国对非洲基础设施投资显著改善了项目周边地区的市场可达性，并在此基础上通过促进企业进入、改善企业绩效以及提升居民就业与消费水平，进而带动了区域经济增长。最后，我们从多个维度对比发现，中国对外基础设施投资的经济效应显著大于其他国家（机构），验证了中国对外基础设施投资模式的相对优势。

abstract: 在全球供应链恢复与重构问题中，企业建立供应链关系的能力是基础。本文将数据要素引入企业间贸易模型，指出数据要素通过减少信息摩擦，并进一步作用于搜寻成本、管理成本和企业供应链网络地位，最终影响供应链关系建立。在实证方面，本文匹配了FactSet Revere 14余万条企业间供应链关系数据和Orbis上市与非上市企业经营数据，利用区域数据规制冲击验证了理论。研究发现：数据要素负向冲击不利于企业供应链关系建立；区域数据规制成为供应链调整的新壁垒，并且在考虑数据流动后仍然存在。机制分析发现：完善的互联网建设和更多潜在供应商从搜寻成本角度缓解负面效应；便捷的物流和更高的运营效率从管理成本角度缓解负面效应；更高的网络地位和更稳定的次级网络从供应链角度缓解负面效应。进一步分析发现，区域数据规制的负面影响因数字化程度、数据非竞争性、供应链复杂度和供应商结构而存在异质性。利用反事实分析发现，区域数据规制减少了中国企业3.5%的数据价值，平均福利损失约14.13%。本文探索了数据要素影响供应链关系建立的丰富机制，为数字经济时代激活数据资源，提升中国供应链韧性提供了新路径。

abstract: 准确刻画微观层面的增值税负担是理解增值税制度运行机制、评估税制改革效果以及分析宏观税负演进的关键。本文基于全国税收调查数据与上市公司数据，系统分析了增值税税负的不同测算方法及可能偏误，并提出统一的微观税负测度方案。研究发现：（1）增值税税负的测度需考虑税额式优惠与出口退税环节，基于教育费附加的推算结果会因免抵退税而被高估；（2）企业层面增值税税负整体呈下降趋势，但在不同规模企业中呈“倒U型”分布，且大企业税负较低与可抵扣进项规模有关；（3）在小规模纳税人制度框架下，部分企业由于税负激励可能产生分拆避税行为；（4）税收优惠与出口退税显著降低微观税负，但也可能导致税源流失。

abstract: 政府财政可持续性问题长期以来是公共经济学研究的重要议题。传统财政可持续性研究主要关注债务与财政收支，忽视了我国地方政府在债务融资和投资过程中同步形成的、能够在未来产生收益的资产型财政资源，缺乏对该类资产如何影响我国地方财政可持续性的讨论。本文聚焦于该类资产中的国有权益资本，首先基于中国工商注册企业数据对中国全样本注册企业实体进行股权穿透，构建股权网络，测算各级地方政府所持有的股权资产规模，并对其分布特征与动态演变进行描述分析。在此基础上，从宏观与微观两个角度，评估了股权资产对中国地方政府财政可持续性的影响。研究发现，股权资产对财政可持续性具有独特作用，宏观层面能够拓展地方政府应对债务压力时的财政调整空间，微观层面则会影响地方政府城投债的市场风险定价。本文的研究结论表明，需充分重视资产型财政资源的识别、管理与统筹利用，以增强我国财政可持续性。

abstract: 本文构建了一个包含自动化发展和异质性劳动力的经济增长框架，将自动化发展分解为水平扩张与垂直进步两个维度来讨论其对劳动收入份额和技能工资的影响，为理解自动化技术冲击与收入分配演变提供了统一的分析框架与机制解释。研究表明：两种自动化分解指标通过有偏影响人均产出和平均工资率引起劳动收入份额的变化，通过市场机制有偏影响技能工资引起技能溢价的变化。在此基础上，本文利用中国2002年以来的宏观数据测算了我国自动化比率和自动化效率的变化路径，从自动化发展的角度对中国劳动收入份额的U型变化进行了解释。本文还利用反事实分析比较了两种自动化分解指标对工资率提升的贡献差异，发现维持两种指标在高水平上的协调是促进收入分配合理化的关键。

abstract: 促进共同富裕，最艰巨最繁重的任务仍然在农村，农村收入不平等已成为推进共同富裕的突出短板。然而，现有文献在探讨农业现代化与共同富裕的关系时，一定程度上忽略了农业现代化转型对农村内部经济结构与社会分层动态演化的深远影响。在此背景下，本文构建了一个包含异质性农户的理论模型，并基于中国家庭追踪调查数据（CFPS）和中国工商注册企业数据从家庭层面实证检验了新型农业经营主体能否降低农村收入不平等。首先，实证发现新型农业经营主体能够显著降低我国农村收入不平等，且此显著影响主要发生在劳动力教育水平较低、年龄较大的家庭中。其次，机制分析表明新型农业经营主体通过增加土地需求和就业需求的方式畅通了农业生产要素流通路径，促进了原农业经营不良家庭的土地转出和农业受雇，进而有效缓解了农村地区收入不平等，推进共同富裕。最后，进一步分析发现，家庭议价能力与劳动力非农转移程度均非阻碍新型农业经营主体发挥普惠作用的关键因素。本文研究可以为实现共同富裕目标和乡村振兴战略提供事实依据与理论支持，对更好地推动新型农业经营主体的健康发展也有启示意义。

abstract: The share of flexible employment in the labour market has continued to rise, and its impact on household financial conditions has attracted growing attention. Using data from the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS), this paper employs a two-way fixed effects model to empirically examine the effect of flexible employment on household financial vulnerability. The empirical results show that flexible employment participation, transition into flexible employment, and sustained flexible employment all significantly reduce household financial vulnerability. Mechanism analysis reveals that flexible employment reduces financial vulnerability by easing credit constraints and strengthening social security coverage. Further analysis demonstrates that transitions from unemployment, farming, and entrepreneurship into flexible employment all significantly lower financial vulnerability. Moreover, high-quality flexible employment significantly reduces financial vulnerability. Importantly, flexible employment helps households cope with health and old-age risks, thereby narrowing their financial risk exposure and contributing to the reduction of vulnerability. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the negative effect of flexible employment on financial vulnerability is stronger for disadvantaged groups, including rural households and those with low physical capital, low human capital, liquidity constraints, and weak social networks. The conclusions of this paper offer valuable insights for policy formulation aimed at promoting high-quality employment and enhancing household risk resilience.

abstract: Popular policy arguments indicate freshwater scarcity leads to civil wars. Yet, studies are unclear about this relationship with arguments based on scarcity, abundance, and human adaptation competing. In this article, I clarify this debate by conducting survival analysis with global data from 1960 to 2023. I construct a short-term freshwater shock variable – separated by positive (flood) and negative (drought) – that addresses the methodological limitations of the literature. My results show that both positive and negative shocks increase the likelihood of civil wars but with different temporal patterns. Negative shocks have immediate same-year positive association with conflict hazard, whereas positive shocks have a one-year delay. Interaction models further indicate that this relationship is not moderated by level of democracy, agriculture-dependence, or ethnic division contexts, while arid conditions amplify the hazard from negative shocks. Conclusions indicate policy must accentuate freshwater concerns to mitigate potential civil wars, as climate change brings drastic freshwater crises.
abstract_zh: 流行的政策论点表明，淡水稀缺会导致内战。然而，相关研究对这一关系尚不明确，基于稀缺、丰裕与人类适应能力的论点相互竞争。本文通过运用1960年至2023年的全球数据进行生存分析，以厘清这一争论。我构建了一个短期淡水冲击变量——按正向（洪水）和负向（干旱）加以区分——以解决文献中的方法论局限。我的结果表明，正向和负向冲击都会增加内战的可能性，但具有不同的时间模式。负向冲击与冲突风险在同年即呈正向关联，而正向冲击则有一年的滞后。交互模型进一步表明，这一关系不受民主水平、农业依赖程度或族群分裂背景的调节，而干旱条件会放大负向冲击带来的风险。结论表明，政策必须强调淡水关切，以缓解潜在的内战，因为气候变化会带来剧烈的淡水危机。
title: Is it abundance or scarcity? Reassessing freshwater resources and civil war onset (1960–2023)
title_zh: 是丰裕还是稀缺？重新评估淡水资源与内战爆发（1960–2023）

abstract: We derive bounds on the rational variation in option‐implied beliefs about market returns. While risk preferences distort option‐implied (or risk‐neutral ) beliefs away from subjective beliefs, one can nonetheless bound risk‐neutral belief movement under a general assumption on the stochastic discount factor. The resulting test requires no knowledge of the objective distribution and allows significantly more flexibility in discount rates than standard volatility tests. Implementing our test empirically using index options, we find that there is so much movement in risk‐neutral beliefs that the bounds are routinely violated. Our results imply significant excess index‐price volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们推导了关于市场回报的期权隐含信念理性变动的界限。尽管风险偏好会使期权隐含（或风险中性）信念偏离主观信念，但在对随机贴现因子的一般假设下，仍可对风险中性信念的变动施加界限。由此得到的检验无需了解客观分布，并且在贴现率方面比标准波动率检验允许更大的灵活性。利用指数期权对我们的检验进行实证实施，我们发现风险中性信念的变动如此之大，以至于这些界限经常被违反。我们的结果意味着显著的指数价格过度波动。
title: Excess Movement in Option‐Implied Beliefs
title_zh: 期权隐含信念中的过度变动

abstract: Energy policies targeting households by income may overlook differences in energy expenditure across the household life cycle. Using 44,581 household-year observations from the China Family Panel Studies (2014–2022), this study distinguishes six stages and estimates income elasticities with two-way fixed effects. Elasticities are positive across all stages, but highest in formation and substantially lower in the remaining stages. Childrearing, burden-peak, and stabilization households nevertheless have higher expenditure than formation-stage households at comparable income and household size. Therefore, higher expenditure and stronger income responsiveness characterise different stages. Durable-goods accumulation offers a possible explanation for the stronger formation-stage response, while consumption structure is associated with income responsiveness across stages. Overall responsiveness is higher in the north than in the south. Among initial gaseous-fuel users, it is higher in rural than in urban areas. These findings support considering family stages alongside income when designing household energy policies. Equipment support during formation could account for both purchase and operating costs, while assistance for childrearing, burden-peak, and stabilization households could reflect actual energy bills. Such measures also need to consider local heating charges and the recurring costs of cleaner fuels.
abstract_zh: 针对按收入划分家庭能源政策可能忽视家庭生命周期中能源支出差异的问题，本研究利用中国家庭追踪调查（2014—2022年）44,581个家庭—年观测值，区分六个阶段，并采用双向固定效应估计收入弹性。各阶段收入弹性均为正，但形成期最高，其余阶段显著较低。然而，在可比收入和家庭规模下，育儿期、负担高峰期和稳定期家庭的支出高于形成期家庭。因此，较高支出与较强收入响应性刻画的是不同阶段。耐用品积累可能解释形成期更强的响应，而消费结构与各阶段收入响应性相关。总体响应性北方高于南方。在初始使用气体燃料的用户中，农村高于城市。这些发现支持在设计家庭能源政策时，将家庭阶段与收入一并考虑。形成期的设备支持可同时覆盖购置成本和运行成本，而对育儿期、负担高峰期和稳定期家庭的援助可反映实际能源账单。此类措施还需考虑地方取暖费用和清洁燃料的经常性成本。

title: Income responsiveness of household energy expenditure across life-cycle stages: Evidence from China
title_zh: 中国家庭能源支出的收入响应性：基于生命周期阶段的证据

abstract: Decarbonizing household heating in coal-dependent economies requires understanding the market actors who intermediate access to solid fuels. Blue coal — a thermally upgraded form of steam coal with lower emissions of local air pollutants — is promoted as a transitional fuel bridging the gap between conventional coal combustion and renewable heating solutions. Despite anti-smog regulations in Poland, its market penetration remains limited. This study examines perceptions, barriers, and drivers of blue coal adoption among Polish solid fuel distributors (n = 208), using ordinal logistic regression with covariate adjustment and robustness checks. Three hypotheses are tested: (H1) whether urbanization and firm size predict perceived substitution potential; (H2) whether regulatory support and consumer environmental awareness outperform price-related variables in predicting market redefinition; and (H3) whether skepticism toward blue coal amplifies expectations of support. H1 was not confirmed, although sparse data on larger and urban firms leave the evidence inconclusive. For H2, the results support a robust association with perceived customer interest (p < 0.001), rather than a general ranking of ecological and regulatory drivers above price-related considerations: price responsiveness remained significant (p ≤ 0.011) and regulatory perception depended on specification (p = 0.053). H3 was not confirmed in its monotonic form; an exploratory post hoc test supported an inverted-U relationship (p = 0.009). As the data capture distributors' perceptions and not household demand, emissions, or costs, they do not justify preferential support for blue coal; verified product information, enforceable fuel-quality standards, and technology-neutral transition support warrant evaluation.
abstract_zh: 在依赖煤炭的经济体中实现家庭供暖脱碳，需要理解那些中介固体燃料获取渠道的市场参与者。蓝煤——一种经过热提质、局部空气污染物排放较低的蒸汽煤——被推广为衔接传统煤炭燃烧与可再生供暖解决方案之间差距的过渡性燃料。尽管波兰实施了反雾霾法规，其市场渗透率仍然有限。本研究考察波兰固体燃料分销商（n = 208）对蓝煤采用的认知、障碍和驱动因素，采用带协变量调整和稳健性检验的序数逻辑回归。研究检验三个假设：（H1）城市化和企业规模是否预测感知替代潜力；（H2）监管支持和消费者环境意识在预测市场重新定义方面是否优于价格相关变量；（H3）对蓝煤的怀疑是否放大对支持的预期。H1未得到证实，尽管较大规模和城市企业的数据稀疏使证据不确定。对于H2，结果支持与感知客户兴趣的稳健关联（p < 0.001），而非生态和监管驱动因素普遍优于价格相关考量：价格响应性仍然显著（p ≤ 0.011），监管感知取决于模型设定（p = 0.053）。H3的单调形式未得到证实；一项探索性事后检验支持倒U型关系（p = 0.009）。由于数据捕捉的是分销商的感知，而非家庭需求、排放或成本，它们不能为优先支持蓝煤提供依据；经过验证的产品信息、可执行的燃料质量标准以及技术中立的转型支持值得评估。
title: Perceived market potential of blue coal in Poland: the role of regulatory signals and consumer demand as seen by fuel distributors
title_zh: 波兰蓝煤的市场潜力感知：燃料分销商视角下监管信号与消费者需求的作用

abstract: EU debt has become a noticeable feature of Europe’s fiscal architecture. However, EU fiscal rules focus solely on national public finances. They have a blind spot for EU debt, which calls their goal of fiscal sustainability into question. This column proposes a simple way to bridge this gap. Under our proposal, additional EU borrowing would be matched by a corresponding reduction in national borrowing. The mechanism would make the fiscal burden of EU debt visible in national statistics without reopening the recently reformed rules. It could also strengthen the safe-asset properties of EU bonds.
abstract_zh: 欧盟债务已成为欧洲财政架构中一个引人注目的特征。然而，欧盟财政规则仅聚焦于国家公共财政，对欧盟债务存在盲点，这使其财政可持续性目标受到质疑。本专栏提出一种弥合这一缺口的简单方法。根据我们的建议，欧盟新增借款将由国家借款的相应减少来匹配。该机制将使欧盟债务的财政负担在国家统计数据中可见，而无需重新开启近期改革的规则。它还可能增强欧盟债券的安全资产属性。
authors: Astrid Lemmer, Alexander Mahle, Karsten Wendorff
title: Mind the gap: Bringing EU debt into the Stability and Growth Pact
title_zh: 关注差距：将欧盟债务纳入《稳定与增长公约》

abstract: The standard prediction is that a higher minimum wage reduces employment among low-wage workers. This column examines the effect of a rise in the minimum wage in California for workers at both large and small fast-food chains. Among smaller chains, employment, the number of establishments, and openings fell, while closures rose. The largest chains remained unchanged, indicating that the policy shifted California’s fast-food market towards its largest chains.
abstract_zh: 标准预测认为，提高最低工资会减少低薪工人的就业。本专栏考察了加利福尼亚州最低工资上调对大型和小型快餐连锁店员工的影响。在较小连锁店中，就业、门店数量和空缺职位均下降，而关闭数量上升。最大型连锁店则保持不变，这表明该政策使加州快餐市场向最大型连锁店倾斜。
authors: Vitor Melo, David Neumark, Liam Sigaud, Gary A. Wagner
title: Establishment-level evidence on California’s fast-food minimum wage
title_zh: 加州快餐业最低工资的机构层面证据

abstract: Global extreme poverty fell substantially between 2003 and 2024, but progress slowed after 2013 and became increasingly uneven. Using harmonized household surveys for 154 countries, covering about 96 percent of the global population, this paper examines changes in incidence, composition, demographic profile, spatial concentration, and environmental exposure of poverty. The number of people living below $3.00 per day fell from more than 2 billion to 781 million. Yet the remaining poor became increasingly concentrated in Sub-Saharan Africa, fragile economies, rural communities, younger populations, groups with limited education, and connected high-poverty subnational regions. In 2024, rural residents account for 73 percent of the extreme poor and children account for 46 percent. Poverty overlaps strongly with drought exposure, although associations with floods, cyclones, and heatwaves are more mixed. Urbanization and educational attainment increased in Sub-Saharan Africa without commensurate poverty reduction, showing that these descriptive correlates do not translate mechanically into progress. Rural residence, limited schooling, and child dependency are most prevalent around the extreme poverty line but remain widespread across much of the lower end of the global income distribution, and distribution-sensitive indicators that capture the entire global distribution confirm the poverty-based rankings.

abstract: Jobs are the primary driver of movements into and out of poverty, yet which kinds of employment transitions are most closely associated with a household’s escape from poverty remains poorly understood. Assembling harmonized longitudinal household surveys for 41 countries that span the full range of development, we estimate the association of poverty exit, poverty entry, and welfare growth with changes in the allocation of a household’s working-age members across wage employment, employer status, and agricultural and non-agricultural self-employment. The welfare gain associated with wage work rises steeply with development while the return to non-agricultural self-employment falls, so that the two reverse rank: in the poorest economies a shift into self-employment is associated with escaping poverty at least as strongly as a shift into wage work, whereas in the richest only wage employment is. A sharp asymmetry separates the two margins of poverty: the composition of a household’s employment predicts whether it climbs out, but access to almost any type of employment predicts whether it avoids falling in. In the poorest and richest economies alike, women’s employment transitions are as strongly, if not more, associated to escaping and avoiding poverty than men’s job transitions.
abstract_zh: 就业是推动人们进出贫困的主要因素，但究竟哪些类型的就业转换与家庭脱贫关系最为密切，仍鲜为人知。本文汇集了覆盖完整发展水平区间的41个国家的统一纵向家庭调查数据，估计脱贫、陷入贫困和福利增长与家庭劳动年龄成员在工资就业、雇主身份以及农业和非农业自雇之间的配置变化之间的关联。工资工作带来的福利收益随发展水平急剧上升，而非农业自雇的回报则下降，从而使二者排序发生逆转：在最贫穷的经济体中，转向自雇与脱贫的关联至少与转向工资就业同样强，而在最富裕的经济体中，只有工资就业才具有这种关联。贫困的两个边际之间存在鲜明的不对称性：家庭就业构成可预测其能否脱贫，但能否获得几乎任何类型的就业则可预测其能否避免陷入贫困。无论在最贫穷还是最富裕的经济体中，女性就业转换与脱贫和避免贫困的关联都不亚于甚至强于男性的工作转换。

abstract: This paper constructs a new global database that links harmonized labor-market information from household surveys to the welfare distributions underlying the global poverty estimates. Covering 150 economies and 96 percent of the world’s population between 2003 and 2024, the database places individuals in the global welfare distribution while recording their education, employment status, and sector of work. This linkage allows us to compare labor-market out-comes between poor and non-poor populations within and across countries over two decades. Decomposing growth in welfare per person between 2003 and 2024 into welfare per worker, the employment rate, and the working-age share shows that welfare per worker accounts for all of the welfare growth in the bottom three quintiles of the global distribution, where the contribution of employment is negative. Relative to the non-poor, poor workers are less educated, substantially more likely to be self-employed, and far more concentrated in agriculture, while employment rates are broadly similar and poor workers work somewhat fewer hours. At the$3.00 poverty line, 61 percent of poor workers have only primary education or less, 79 percent are self-employed, and 66 percent work in agriculture, compared with 25 percent, 35 percent, and 20 percent among the non-poor. Counterfactual simulations suggest that narrowing gaps in education, employment type, and sector would reduce poverty substantially, and at the$3.00 line by more than raising employment. At the higher $8.30 line raising employment matters as much, and nearly all of its effect comes from women’s employment.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新的全球数据库，将家庭调查中经过统一协调的劳动力市场信息与全球贫困估计所依据的福利分布相连接。该数据库覆盖2003年至2024年间150个经济体和全球96%的人口，将个体置于全球福利分布中，同时记录其教育程度、就业状况和工作部门。这一连接使我们能够比较二十年来国家内部及国家之间贫困与非贫困人口的劳动力市场结果。将2003年至2024年间人均福利增长分解为人均劳动者福利、就业率和劳动年龄人口占比，结果显示，在全球分布最低三个五分位组中，人均劳动者福利贡献了全部福利增长，而就业的贡献为负。相对于非贫困劳动者，贫困劳动者受教育程度更低，自雇的可能性大幅更高，并且远更集中于农业，而就业率大体相似，贫困劳动者的工作时间略少。在3.00美元贫困线处，61%的贫困劳动者仅受过小学或更低教育，79%为自雇，66%从事农业，而非贫困人口中这一比例分别为25%、35%和20%。反事实模拟表明，缩小教育、就业类型和部门方面的差距将大幅减少贫困，且在3.00美元线处，其效果大于提高就业。在更高的8.30美元线处，提高就业的作用同样重要，且其几乎全部效应来自女性就业。

abstract: The rapid advance of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has sparked intense debate about its effects on labor markets. We draw on over 700 million online job postings to present new evidence covering 110 economies. Demand has declined by nearly 10 percent in more AI-exposed occupations but, surprisingly, this impact has stabilized even as AI has become more capable. To understand this pattern, we develop a novel measure of AI adoption based on references to emerging AI skills in job postings. Demand for these skills has grown rapidly, particularly in more exposed occupations. Indeed, firms with stronger demand for AI skills exhibit faster growth in job postings, even in more exposed occupations. AI appears to be reshaping labor demand by both compressing hiring in more exposed occupations and generating new opportunities for workers with AI skills.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）的快速进步引发了关于其对劳动力市场影响的激烈争论。我们基于超过7亿条在线招聘信息，呈现覆盖110个经济体的新证据。在AI暴露程度更高的职业中，需求下降了近10%，但令人意外的是，即便AI能力不断增强，这一影响仍趋于稳定。为理解这一模式，我们基于招聘信息中对新兴AI技能的提及，构建了一种新的AI采用度量指标。对这些技能的需求迅速增长，尤其是在暴露程度更高的职业中。事实上，对AI技能需求更强的企业，其招聘信息增长更快，即便是在暴露程度更高的职业中也是如此。AI似乎正在通过压缩暴露程度更高职业的招聘，以及为具备AI技能的劳动者创造新机会，来重塑劳动力需求。
authors: Mr. Sakai Ando & Mr. Divya Kirti & Willa Lin & Assyifa Szami Ilman
title: How is Labor Demand Changing as AI Improves? New Global Evidence
title_zh: 随着人工智能进步，劳动力需求如何变化？新的全球证据

abstract: We study an agency model in which the principal knows the agent-optimal actions in response to K “known” contracts but is unaware of other actions available or their costs, and seeks a contract to maximize worst-case profits. The optimal contract is a mixture of the known contracts and output. Moreover, when K=1, the single known contract maximizes the principal’s profit guarantee, whereas with two known contracts, the optimal mixture puts positive weight on one of the known contracts. Our methodology is straightforward to implement, a point that we demonstrate using data from an experimental study of different incentive schemes.
title: Robust Contracts: A Revealed Preference Approach
title_zh: 稳健合同：一种显示偏好方法

abstract: This paper exploits the historical system of salt taxation in France to study the impact of extractive taxes on long-term economic development. Salt tax rates exhibited significant spatial variation, leading to discontinuous jumps in salt prices. Adopting a spatial regression-discontinuity design, we estimate the causal effect of the tax using original historical data. We extract geolocalized individual-level information on almost 70 million individuals living near tax borders between 1400 and 1900. These exogenous rate differentials had large effects, as areas burdened by lower rates exhibit higher economic development. These effects emerged after the tax’s introduction and persisted post-abrogation to the present day.
title: Taxation with a Grain of Salt: The Long-Term Effect of Extractive Fiscal Institutions on Development
title_zh: 盐税与长期发展：榨取性财政制度对发展的长期影响

abstract: We study the labor market impact of unplanned pregnancy among women using long-acting reversible contraceptives to delay pregnancy. While most women successfully delay, some have unplanned pregnancies, providing quasi-random variation in pregnancy timing. Analyzing linked health and labor market data from Sweden, we find that unplanned pregnancies halt women’s career progression, resulting in income losses of 19% five years later. We find similar effects of unplanned births among women using short-acting reversible contraceptives. Using pregnancy as an instrument for birth in a dynamic treatment effect framework, effects of unplanned children are more detrimental for younger women and those enrolled in education.
title: The Labor Market Returns to Delaying Pregnancy
title_zh: 延迟怀孕的劳动力市场回报

abstract: Long-term debt is the main source of firm financing in the United States. We show that accounting for debt maturity is essential for understanding business cycle dynamics. We develop a macroeconomic model with defaultable long-term debt and costly equity issuance. Long-term debt creates incentives for firms to raise leverage and dilute outstanding claims. When equity issuance is costly, this debt dilution channel mitigates net worth losses through balance sheet effects, dampening investment responses to negative financial shocks. Using firm-level data, we estimate equity issuance costs and embed them in a DSGE model, where credit supply shocks dominate business cycle fluctuations.
title: Corporate Debt Maturity and Business Cycle Fluctuations
title_zh: 企业债务期限与经济周期波动

abstract: This paper studies how digitalization affects consumption inequality. We assemble a novel dataset of digital technology in consumption, and establish that high-income households consume a larger share of digitally produced products than low-income households. We show that these products become relatively cheaper, which benefits rich households and contributes to consumption inequality. In a structural model with heterogeneous workers and nonhomothetic preferences, we quantify the impact of digitalization on consumption inequality. The model demonstrates that a U-shaped income polarization translates into J-shaped welfare changes, as the price effect mutes income gains at the bottom while amplifying them at the top.
title: Consumption Inequality in the Digital Age
title_zh: 数字时代的消费不平等

abstract: We propose a simple empirical strategy that combines (i) administrative firm-level data, (ii) identified monetary policy shocks, and (iii) survey data on financing activities. The key novelty is a firm-level proxy for the likelihood of being credit constrained, constructed using data on realized outcomes of financing requests. Leveraging heterogeneity in the proxy and employment responses to monetary policy shocks, we find that credit constraints amplify monetary policy transmission and account for roughly two thirds of the aggregate employment response to monetary policy. Our findings imply redistributive effects across firms (large firms barely respond to monetary policy) and a state-dependence to the current tightness of constraints.
title: Monetary Policy and Employment: Do Financial Constraints Matter?
title_zh: 货币政策与就业：金融约束是否重要？

abstract: The External-Instrument SVAR-IV (Proxy-SVAR) framework is extended to accommodate non-invertible and non-recoverable shocks, with formal tests provided for recoverability and invertibility. The approach allows the estimation of unitvariance shocks, absolute impulse responses, and variance decompositions for recoverable shocks, and it coincides with the standard method when shocks are invertible. Simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the Internal-Instrument approach due to greater flexibility. Application to a monetary policy VAR uncovers substantial effects of monetary policy on prices, differing from previous findings.
abstract_zh: 本文将外部工具SVAR-IV（代理SVAR）框架扩展至可容纳不可逆且不可恢复的冲击，并为可恢复性与可逆性提供了正式检验。该方法允许估计单位方差冲击、绝对脉冲响应以及可恢复冲击的方差分解，且当冲击可逆时与标准方法一致。模拟表明，由于具有更大的灵活性，该方法优于内部工具方法。将其应用于货币政策VAR，揭示了货币政策对价格的显著影响，这与以往研究结果不同。
title: Generalised External-Instrument SVAR Analysis
title_zh: 广义外部工具SVAR分析

abstract: While prior evidence suggests that school choice lottery winners have lower adult criminality, there is little evidence on how school choice lotteries impact non-applicants. We leverage variation in actual lottery winners, conditional on expected lottery winners, to link the displacement of middle school peers to adult criminal outcomes. We find that non-applicant, lower-risk boys are more likely to be arrested as adults when lottery applicants from their neighborhood do not attend their assigned middle school. Our estimated effects of an applicant's departure on students left behind are similar in magnitude to the positive effects experienced by a lottery winner.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有证据表明，学校选择抽签中签者的成年犯罪率较低，但关于学校选择抽签如何影响非申请者，证据仍然很少。我们利用实际抽签中签者在给定预期中签者条件下的变异，将初中同辈的位移与成年犯罪结果联系起来。我们发现，当来自同一社区且参与抽签的申请者未就读其被分配的初中时，非申请者中风险较低的男孩在成年后更有可能被逮捕。我们估计的申请者离开对留守学生的影响，在量级上与抽签中签者所经历的正向效应相似。
title: When Opportunity Costs Others: The Spillover E ects of School Choice Lotteries on Criminality
title_zh: 当机会成本波及他人：学校选择抽签对犯罪行为的溢出效应
